name: Shinkansen reserved seats (Tokaido, Sanyo and Kyushu lines)
city: Tokyo, Nagoya, Kyoto, Osaka, Hiroshima, Fukuoka
intro: Japan's high-speed bullet trains. The Tokaido, Sanyo and Kyushu lines link Tokyo, Nagoya, Kyoto, Osaka, Hiroshima and Fukuoka. On most days there are seats to spare, but at holiday peaks reserved seats on popular trains can sell out soon after they go on sale.

facts.location: Tokyo to Fukuoka, via Nagoya, Kyoto, Osaka and Hiroshima
facts.bookAhead: One month: seats open at 10:00 on the same date a month before

statusNote: Read from the official JR Central and JR-WEST English pages.
howToBuy: For the Tokaido, Sanyo and Kyushu Shinkansen (Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Hiroshima, Fukuoka), book on SmartEX or JR-WEST Online Train Reservation. Both are in English and take overseas credit cards.
Seats for a given day go on sale at 10:00 Japan time on the same date one month before. For example, seats for December 25 open on November 25.
Japan Rail Pass holders can also reserve seats online.
Busy times sell out fast: New Year, late March to early April, Golden Week (late April to early May) and Obon (mid-August).
rulesToKnow: SmartEX releases some products one year ahead at 05:30, but ordinary reserved seats open one month ahead.
If the same date doesn't exist in the previous month (for example March 31), sales start on the 1st of the travel month.

soldOut.label: Shinkansen tickets and rail passes on Klook
Ride in an unreserved car where the train has one: no booking needed, but expect to queue

faq.q: When do Shinkansen tickets go on sale?
faq.a: Reserved seats go on sale at 10:00 Japan time, one month before the travel date (the same date in the previous month).

faq.q: Can I book the Shinkansen from outside Japan?
faq.a: Yes. SmartEX and JR-WEST Online Train Reservation both have English sites and accept overseas credit cards.

faq.q: What if all reserved seats are gone?
faq.a: Most trains have unreserved cars, though the Nozomi is all-reserved at the busiest holiday times. Seats also come back as other people change their plans, so keep checking.

sources.quote: Reserved seats go on sale from 10:00 AM one month before the departure date of your train (the same day of the previous month).
starting at 10:00 am (JST) on same day of preceding month.
